operation.description: Operation to perform. `mutate_residues` applies point mutations to `sequence`; `check_wt_consistency` validates that mutation notations match a wild-type reference and produce the given mutant.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's `sequence` into the `sequence` input when omitted.

sequence.description: Reference protein sequence to mutate (used by `mutate_residues`).

wild_type_sequence.description: Wild-type reference sequence for `check_wt_consistency`. Each mutation notation's wild-type letter is checked against this sequence.

mutant_sequence.description: Candidate mutant sequence for `check_wt_consistency`. Compared against the wild-type after applying the notation.

mapping.description: Position-to-residue mutation map (1-indexed positions as string keys → single-letter target residue). Example: `{"73": "Q"}` mutates residue 73 to Q.

mutation_notation.description: Mutation notation strings of form `<WT-AA><1-indexed-position><MUT-AA>` (e.g. `V73Q`, `K10A`). Combined with `mapping` to form the full mutation set.

allow_noop.description: When true, allow no-op mutations where the target residue equals the wild-type (silently ignored).

strict_wild_type.description: When true, enforce that mutation-notation wild-type letters match the reference sequence; mismatches raise. Disable for sloppy LLM-emitted notation.

output_name.description: Stem name for the output FASTA artifact.
